name: Steam Bridge (dev)
author: MickeyDisn
description: Dev-only remote control for a running Sandustry session. Publishes a globalThis.__sk command surface so the CDP tools in tools/ can inspect and drive a live world — load saves, read state, place structures, compile and attach processes — without restarting the game. No gameplay effect.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, globalThis.__sk is removed and the mod's own storage is wiped. Turn this off for any build you actually play.
